afternoon_break.details: No complete closure; brief 20-30 minute queue pauses for Naivedyam (food offerings) during First Bell, Second Bell, and Night Bell.

daily_schedule.details_and_significance: Opening of temple doors and sacred preparation for morning rituals.
Awakening ritual recited in front of Bangaru Vakili to wake the Lord with holy hymns.
Sanctum cleansing and initial direct viewing of the deity post-awakening.
Garland decoration of Moola Virat (Public ticket holders allowed Tue, Wed, Thu).
Recitation of 1,008 sacred names and daily accounts reading before Koluvu Srinivasa.
Morning sacred food offering offering to the Lord behind closed curtains.
Protocol, judiciary, and high-priority VIP entry quota.

daily_schedule.ritual_name: Special Entry Darshan (SED ₹300) & General Sarva Darshan
daily_schedule.details_and_significance: Morning slot clearance for paid ticket holders and general queue lines.
Celestial wedding ritual and daytime Arjitha Sevas conducted in external mandapams.
Midday food offering to the deity.
Afternoon continuous general darshan queue clearance including pedestrian (footpath) pilgrims.
Lighting of 1,000 ghee lamps outside temple followed by Mada Street processional swing.
Evening pujas, night food offerings, and sanctum cleansing.
Late-night queue clearance for non-ticketed general pilgrims.
Nightly bedding ritual where Bhoga Srinivasa Swamy is put to rest with lullabies.
